rationales.deterministic-orchestration-v2: forms (a), (b), and (c) — the implemented framework deterministically constructs a prompt, calls the LLM to generate or revise an adaptation manager, executes it, verifies every test run, and feeds violations back for another iteration. Code accepts a candidate only when it passes all checks and aborts after 10 unsuccessful iterations, so verification outcomes deterministically trigger acceptance, retry, or termination; the LLM performs the bounded generation/repair task but does not control the outer workflow.
